Suno said in February 2026 that it had 2M paid subscribers, and 7M songs/day comes from leaked investor materials. The round later closed at $400M+ and a $5.4B valuation, led by Bond, which could be added as an update. The claims about label licensing deals and fund use are the writer's interpretation and were not checked.

Google blog, June 24, 2026: computer use became a built-in tool in Gemini 3.5 Flash, previously only available as a standalone Gemini 2.5 computer-use model. The paragraph about Gemini 3.5 Pro (Deep Think, 2M context, slipped to July) is backed only by low-quality sources and is not in Google's post. The Gemini API changelog shows no 3.5 Pro release through September. Treat that paragraph as unverified speculation.

Two DMA decisions dated July 16, 2026 are confirmed: 11 Android features for rival AI assistants, and anonymized search data sharing from January 2027. Sources give the Android deadline as 'July 2027' (Anadolu) or 'Android 18 by August 1, 2027', so 'most by August 2027' is acceptable. The Commission press release was not fetched directly. Google's security objection was not independently confirmed in the fetched texts but is widely reported.

Gemini API changelog, July 21, 2026: gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite reached GA, and temperature/top_p/top_k were deprecated. Secondary reports say the parameters are now ignored and will return HTTP 400 in future generations. The article's wording 'a change that will break existing code' slightly overstates it, since they are currently ignored, not rejected. No Gemini 3.5 Pro release appears in the changelog.

Both happened on July 27, 2026. Dario Amodei's position statement says Anthropic 'has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models' and backs chip export controls, cracking down on distillation, and mandatory safety testing. Cognizant expanded the partnership and became a Claude Partner Network Global Premier Partner. The article is vague and never says what the position actually is, but it contains no false claims.
